title: An intra-host mathematical model for rabies infection with structured axonal transport and post-exposure control strategies
abstract: We propose a novel intra-host mathematical model for rabies virus infection, which mechanistically integrates the main stages of viral progression from the inoculation site to the salivary glands. The model is formulated as a system of nonlinear ordinary differential equations coupling the dynamics of local muscle infection, nonlinear viral capture by peripheral nerve endings (modeled by a Hill function), structured retrograde axonal transport as a chain of successive compartments, central nervous system invasion, salivary dissemination, a local effector immune response, and three time-dependent post-exposure control strategies. A key novelty lies in the explicit representation of the neurotropic progression of the virus via discrete axonal steps, offering a suitable framework to study therapeutic windows and optimized interventions. Mathematical analysis establishes the positivity and boundedness of solutions as well as the existence and uniqueness of a global solution. A disease-free equilibrium is identified, and a basic reproduction number R 0 is derived, defining a threshold for local infection establishment. A local stability condition is stated, and a Lya-punov function is constructed to demonstrate the global asymptotic stability of the disease-free equilibrium when R 0 < 1, valid for any Hill cooperativity q ≥ 1. A mechanistic neuroinvasion index R n is also proposed to quantify the probability of virus progression to the central nervous system via the axonal chain. Finally, an optimal control problem is formulated to minimize viral load and salivary dissemination under intervention cost constraints, necessary optimality conditions are derived via Pontryagin’s maximum principle, and the resulting optimality system is solved numerically via a forward–backward sweep method, whose performance is benchmarked against a constant-effort strategy. This model constitutes a rigorous basis for evaluating post-exposure prophylactic strategies.

abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于 狂犬病病毒 感染的新型 宿主 内数学模型,该模型从机械上整合了从接种部位到唾液腺的病毒进展的主要阶段。该模型被公式化为非线性常微分方程系统,耦合局部肌肉感染的动力学、周围神经末梢的非线性病毒捕获(由希尔函数建模)、作为连续隔室链的结构化逆行轴突运输、中枢神经系统入侵、唾液传播、局部效应器免疫应答以及三种依赖时间的暴露后控制策略。一个关键的新颖之处在于通过离散的轴突步骤明确表示病毒的神经营养进展,为研究治疗窗口和优化干预措施提供了合适的框架。数学分析确定解的正性和有界性以及全局解的存在性和唯一性。确定无病平衡,并导出基本繁殖数 R 0,定义局部感染建立的阈值。规定了局部稳定性条件,并构建了 Lya-punov 函数来证明当 R 0 < 1 时无病平衡的全局渐近稳定性,对于任何 Hill 协同性 q ≥ 1 都有效。还提出了机械神经侵袭指数 R n 来量化病毒通过轴突链进展到中枢神经系统的概率。最后,制定最优控制问题,以在干预成本约束下最大限度地减少病毒载量和唾液传播,通过庞特里亚金极大值原理导出必要的最优性条件,并通过前向-后向扫描方法对所得最优系统进行数值求解,其性能以不断努力策略为基准。该模型构成了评估暴露后预防策略的严格基础。

title: Computational design and prioritization of putative peptide inhibitors targeting rabies virus glycoprotein using machine learning, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics
abstract: Rabies is the most lethal viral zoonotic diseases worldwide. The rabies virus glycoprotein (RABV-G) which mediates host cell recognition and viral entry; it represents a therapeutic target for the development of novel anti-viral agents. In the present study, a computational peptide design strategy was employed to design peptide inhibitors against RABV-G. Peptide sequences were designed from the receptor binding region of α-bungarotoxin through mutation and optimisation while eliminating neurotoxic properties. A hybrid machine learning-deep framework was used for toxicity screening. The selected non-toxic peptides were analysed through framework of different tools for Physiochemical characterization, antiviral activity prediction, molecular docking, binding affinity and molecular dynamic simulation were performed to analyse peptide RABV-G interactions. A three-dimensional model of RABV-G was generated using SWISS MODEL and validated through Ramchandran plot analysis with 92.5% residues within favoured regions. Binding pocket analysis identified key residues involved in peptide binding including Glu272, Glu279., Asp283, Lys276 and Arg297. Among the evaluated candidates, MKMKCHTTATMKIV (P40) shown the most favourable docking with a HADDOCK scores − 90 ± 3.8, and binding free energy of -10.3kcal/mol, followed by CLDLGYTIVCHTTATSPI (P3), MKIVCHTTATSPMKV (P21), and MKIVCHTTMKSPMK (P25). Molecular dynamic simulations (100ns) analysed that P40 and P25 formed highly stable complexes with RABV-G, exhibiting low RMSD and RMSF fluctuation with intermolecular interaction, and favourable free energy landscapes and stable conformational through simulation period. This study design shows the α-bungarotoxin derived peptides can target RABV-G and P440 can be promising lead candidate for development of peptide-based drug delivery.

source_records.abstract: A critical, annotated version of Narlikar’s iconic novel about a cybervirus attack by an advanced alien species—with updated text and added material. A year before Robin Cook’s Invasion (1997)—in which an alien force activates a latent biological virus in humans—and almost a decade before Liu Cixin’s The Remembrance of Earth’s Past trilogy (2008–2010)—in which humanity’s scientific progress is curtailed by an alien supercomputer’s “sophon-lock”—Jayant Vishnu Narlikar’s Virus (1996) painted a similar scenario. In his novel, a cybervirus broadcast by an advanced, extraterrestrial species invades Earth and freezes its digital infrastructure: a prelude to an alien invasion. The novel, first published in Marathi, recounts how vast radio arrays on Earth intercept a seemingly innocuous message from an unknown planet orbiting Barnard’s Star. The radio signal, sent six years prior, coalesces into a cybervirus that has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos—an alien first strike to prevent humanity from evolving further. This book—a critical, annotated version of Virus, edited and revised by Sami Ahmad Khan—reissues Narlikar’s iconic novel with updated text and added dimensions. It includes detailed annotations that locate the technology of the text along the axis of contemporary scientific thought, as well as critical essays that focus on the literary, political, and sociocultural dimensions of the novel; essays on Narlikar’s role in India’s science and science fiction; an exclusive conversation with the author; bibliographical information on his works; and a bonus short story. Contributions by Sami Ahmad Khan, Nilam Ingole, Priteegandha Naik, Jayant V. Narlikar, and Dibyadyuti Roy.

title_zh: 使用机器学习、分子对接和分子动力学对针对 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白的假定肽抑制剂进行计算设计和优先排序
source_body_en: Rabies is the most lethal viral zoonotic diseases worldwide. The rabies virus glycoprotein (RABV-G) which mediates host cell recognition and viral entry; it represents a therapeutic target for the development of novel anti-viral agents. In the present study, a computational peptide design strategy was employed to design peptide inhibitors against RABV-G. Peptide sequences were designed from the receptor binding region of α-bungarotoxin through mutation and optimisation while eliminating neurotoxic properties. A hybrid machine learning-deep framework was used for toxicity screening. The selected non-toxic peptides were analysed through framework of different tools for Physiochemical characterization, antiviral activity prediction, molecular docking, binding affinity and molecular dynamic simulation were performed to analyse peptide RABV-G interactions. A three-dimensional model of RABV-G was generated using SWISS MODEL and validated through Ramchandran plot analysis with 92.5% residues within favoured regions. Binding pocket analysis identified key residues involved in peptide binding including Glu272, Glu279., Asp283, Lys276 and Arg297. Among the evaluated candidates, MKMKCHTTATMKIV (P40) shown the most favourable docking with a HADDOCK scores − 90 ± 3.8, and binding free energy of -10.3kcal/mol, followed by CLDLGYTIVCHTTATSPI (P3), MKIVCHTTATSPMKV (P21), and MKIVCHTTMKSPMK (P25). Molecular dynamic simulations (100ns) analysed that P40 and P25 formed highly stable complexes with RABV-G, exhibiting low RMSD and RMSF fluctuation with intermolecular interaction, and favourable free energy landscapes and stable conformational through simulation period. This study design shows the α-bungarotoxin derived peptides can target RABV-G and P440 can be promising lead candidate for development of peptide-based drug delivery.

title: Burden and trends of human rabies in Ethiopia, 1990–2023: A national and subnational systematic analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023
abstract: Background: Rabies remains a significant public health threat in low- and middle-income countries. Ethiopia ranks as the second most affected country in Africa, reporting over 2700 human deaths and 193 748 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) annually. Despite existing control measures, challenges related to treatment accessibility and implementation persist. Aim: To estimate rabies-associated incidence, mortality and DALYs rate in Ethiopia from 1990 to 2023. Setting: Eleven regional states and two city administrations in Ethiopia. Methods: This study utilised data from Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 study. Age-standardised incidence, mortality and DALY rates were estimated. Trends over time were examined using total percentage and annual percentage change with corresponding 95% uncertainty intervals (UIs). Variations by age groups, regions and year were compared. Results: Between 1990 and 2023, the burden of rabies in Ethiopia declined significantly. The incidence rate decreased from 8.4 (95% UI: 1.1, 28.7) to 1.4 (95% UI: 0.18, 4.7); mortality declined from 7.4 (95% UI: 0.79, 27.3) to 1.4 (95% UI: 0.18, 4.6); and DALYs dropped from 439.4 (95% UI: 49.3, 1605.6) to 78.3 (95% UI: 9.5, 257.9) per 100 000 population. Individuals aged 5–14 years bore the highest rabies burden in all metrics. The Southwest, Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples’ Regional State, Amhara, and Oromia regions exhibited the highest rabies burden in Ethiopia. Conclusion: Despite the burden of human rabies decreasing significantly between 1990 and 2023 in Ethiopia, the problem persists with substantial variations across age groups, regions and years. Contribution: These findings underscore the need for targeted human rabies prevention and control strategies in Ethiopia by identifying high-burden geographic areas and the age groups at greatest risk.

title: Engineering a low cytotoxicity recombinant rabies virus neurotracer via N-gene recoding
abstract: ABSTRACT Viral-vector-based tracers have proven invaluable for mapping neural circuits. Rabies virus (RV)-based retrograde trans-monosynaptic tracers have been widely used for depicting the input neural circuit of targeted neuronal populations. However, the cytotoxicity of the RV tracer limits its application. Here, we employed the synthetic attenuated virus engineering technology to recode the N gene of the RV SAD-B19 strain by codon pair deoptimization to generate attenuated RV tracers. The characteristics of the recoded RV tracers were tested both in vitro and in vivo . The full-length recoded N gene abolished viral rescue, whereas the partial recoded N gene supported successful viral recovery. Compared to its parent, the recoded RV trans-monosynaptic tracer exhibited lower cytotoxicity and labeled more input neurons. It can also robustly express proteins to visualize the neuronal morphology and manipulate the neural circuit activity. Collectively, our work generated a new retrograde trans-monosynaptic tool, which complements existing neural circuit tracers. IMPORTANCE Viral vectors play an important role across multiple fields in biomedicine. In the neuroscience community, rabies virus (RV)-based retrograde trans-monosynaptic tracers have been widely used to map the input neural circuits of targeted neuronal populations. However, the inherent cytotoxicity of RV-based tracers limits their broader application. In this study, we utilized synthetic attenuated virus engineering technology to recode the RV N gene, generating an attenuated neurotracer that will significantly benefit future neuroscience research.

title: Atypical Rabies Encephalomyelitis Following Incomplete Post-Exposure Prophylaxis: Delayed Serological Diagnosis and Survival in an Adolescent.
abstract: Rabies is an almost invariably fatal viral encephalitis classically characterized by hydrophobia and aerophobia. Atypical presentations lacking these hallmark features are uncommon and frequently result in diagnostic delay, particularly in partially immunized individuals. Reported is a 15-year-old previously healthy boy who developed progressive encephalomyelitis 25 days after sustaining a Category III jackal bite. Although he completed post-exposure rabies vaccination, rabies immunoglobulin was not administered. He presented with quadriparesis and altered sensorium without hydrophobia or aerophobia. Initial rabies reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) antibody testing were negative. Serial evaluation subsequently demonstrated rising rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers in both serum and CSF, confirming rabies encephalitis. With intensive supportive care, the patient survived the acute illness but was discharged with persistent neurological deficits. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges of atypical rabies and underscores the importance of complete post-exposure prophylaxis.
journal: The American journal of tropical medicine and hygiene

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent who developed atypical rabies encephalomyelitis following an incomplete post-exposure prophylaxis regimen after a Category III jackal bite. The patient exhibited symptoms such as quadriparesis and altered sensorium without the classic signs of hydrophobia or aerophobia. Initial diagnostic tests, including rabies reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) antibody testing, were negative, but serial evaluation revealed rising rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers in serum and CSF, confirming the diagnosis. Despite the absence of rabies immunoglobulin, the patient survived with persistent neurological deficits. The case emphasizes the diagnostic challenges of atypical rabies and the necessity of complete post-exposure prophylaxis. The study is a single case report, which limits the generalizability of the findings, and the evidence is based on clinical observations and serological testing, which may not be sufficient to establish broader implications.

title: The molecular interactions of viruses with apolipoproteins: Evidence, Mechanisms, and Therapeutic Implications.
abstract: Host lipid metabolism is extensively hijacked by viruses to support their replication cycle. Apolipoproteins, the core protein components of lipoprotein particles, mediate lipid transport, receptor recognition, and immune regulation, making them key host targets for diverse viruses. This review systematically examines the molecular mechanisms underlying virus-apolipoprotein interactions and establishes a classification framework distinguishing direct from indirect modes of action. Direct interactions involve physical binding between viral components and apolipoproteins or their receptors, exemplified by hepatitis C virus (HCV) ApoE-dependent lipoviroparticle assembly, hepatitis B virus (HBV) ApoE-mediated entry, Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) spike protein binding to high-density lipoprotein (HDL)-associated apolipoproteins, and rabies virus ApoD-glycoprotein interaction. Indirect mechanisms include viral regulation of apolipoprotein expression through epigenetic modifications, cytokines, and oxidative stress. We also compare the differential effects of ApoE2, ApoE3, and ApoE4 subtypes on infection susceptibility and disease severity across HCV, human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1), and SARS-CoV-2. The clinical-pathological consequences, including hepatic steatosis, atherosclerosis (AS), dyslipidemia, and thrombotic complications, are discussed, and therapeutic strategies targeting lipid metabolism are critically evaluated. We close by outlining unresolved questions and suggesting future research directions leveraging single-cell multi-omics, spatial biology, and organoid models.

Apolipoproteins, the core protein components of lipoprotein particles, mediate lipid transport, receptor recognition, and immune regulation, making them key host targets for diverse viruses. This review systematically examines the molecular mechanisms underlying virus-apolipoprotein interactions and establishes a classification framework distinguishing direct from indirect modes of action. Direct interactions involve physical binding between viral components and apolipoproteins or their receptors, exemplified by hepatitis C virus (HCV) ApoE-dependent lipoviroparticle assembly, hepatitis B virus (HBV) ApoE-mediated entry, Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) spike protein binding to high-density lipoprotein (HDL)-associated apolipoproteins, and rabies virus ApoD-glycoprotein interaction. Indirect mechanisms include viral regulation of apolipoprotein expression through epigenetic modifications, cytokines, and oxidative stress. We also compare the differential effects of ApoE2, ApoE3, and ApoE4 subtypes on infection susceptibility and disease severity across HCV, human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1), and SARS-CoV-2. The clinical-pathological consequences, including hepatic steatosis, atherosclerosis (AS), dyslipidemia, and thrombotic complications, are discussed, and therapeutic strategies targeting lipid metabolism are critically evaluated. We close by outlining unresolved questions and suggesting future research directions leveraging single-cell multi-omics, spatial biology, and organoid models.
title_original: The molecular interactions of viruses with apolipoproteins: Evidence, Mechanisms, and Therapeutic Implications.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on rabies virus and rabies disease, examining its molecular interactions with apolipoproteins. The central question is how rabies virus exploits host lipid metabolism and apolipoproteins to support its replication cycle and pathogenesis.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of molecular mechanisms of virus-apolipoprotein interactions. It includes a classification framework distinguishing direct and indirect modes of action, with evidence drawn from studies on rabies virus, hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1), and SARS-CoV-2. The review does not explicitly report meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that rabies virus interacts directly with apolipoproteins, such as ApoD, through its glycoprotein to facilitate infection. It also highlights indirect mechanisms where the virus modulates apolipoprotein expression via epigenetic changes, cytokines, and oxidative stress. These findings establish a framework for understanding the role of apolipoproteins in viral pathogenesis.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies gaps in understanding the differential effects of ApoE subtypes (ApoE2, ApoE3, ApoE4) on infection susceptibility and disease severity in rabies virus and other related viruses. Additionally, the mechanisms by which rabies virus influences lipid metabolism and its broader clinical implications remain underexplored.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests future research should focus on leveraging single-cell multi-omics, spatial biology, and organoid models to better understand the molecular interactions between rabies virus and apolipoproteins. These approaches could inform the development of targeted therapeutic strategies for rabies disease.

It outlines both direct and indirect mechanisms, including physical binding to apolipoproteins and regulation of their expression. The study highlights the role of apolipoproteins in lipid transport, immune regulation, and disease progression, while identifying gaps in understanding the impact of ApoE subtypes on infection outcomes. The review concludes with recommendations for future research using advanced technologies to uncover new therapeutic targets for rabies disease.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对病毒-载脂蛋白相互作用的分子机制的系统分析。它包括区分直接和间接作用模式的分类框架,证据来自 狂犬病病毒、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV)、人类免疫缺陷病毒 1 型 (HIV-1) 和 SARS-CoV-2 的研究。该综述没有明确报告荟萃分析或汇总估计。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出的结论是,狂犬病病毒 通过其糖蛋白直接与载脂蛋白(如 ApoD)相互作用以促进感染。它还强调了病毒通过表观遗传变化、细胞因子和氧化应激调节载脂蛋白表达的间接机制。这些发现为理解载脂蛋白在病毒 发病机制 中的作用建立了一个框架。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述指出了在理解 ApoE 亚型(ApoE2、ApoE3、ApoE4)对 狂犬病病毒 和其他相关病毒的感染易感性和疾病严重程度的差异影响方面存在的差距。此外,狂犬病病毒 影响脂质代谢的机制及其更广泛的临床意义仍有待探索。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该评论建议未来的研究应侧重于利用单细胞多组学、空间生物学和类器官模型,以更好地了解 狂犬病病毒 和载脂蛋白之间的分子相互作用。这些方法可以为 狂犬病 疾病的靶向治疗策略的开发提供信息。

abstract_zh: 宿主 脂质代谢被病毒广泛劫持以支持其复制周期。载脂蛋白是脂蛋白颗粒的核心蛋白成分,介导脂质转运、受体识别和免疫调节,使其成为多种病毒的关键 宿主 靶点。这篇综述系统地研究了病毒-载脂蛋白相互作用的分子机制,并建立了区分直接和间接作用模式的分类框架。直接相互作用涉及病毒成分和载脂蛋白或其受体之间的物理结合,例如丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)ApoE依赖性脂病毒颗粒组装、乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)ApoE介导的进入、严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)刺突蛋白与高密度脂蛋白(HDL)相关载脂蛋白的结合以及狂犬病病毒 ApoD-糖蛋白相互作用。间接机制包括病毒通过表观遗传修饰、细胞因子和氧化应激对载脂蛋白表达的调节。我们还比较了 ApoE2、ApoE3 和 ApoE4 亚型对 HCV、人类免疫缺陷病毒 1 型 (HIV-1) 和 SARS-CoV-2 感染易感性和疾病严重程度的不同影响。讨论了临床病理后果,包括肝脂肪变性、动脉粥样硬化(AS)、血脂异常和血栓并发症,并严格评估了针对脂质代谢的治疗策略。最后,我们概述了尚未解决的问题,并建议利用单细胞多组学、空间生物学和类器官模型的未来研究方向。

title: Molecular basis of behavioral and cognitive changes induced by neurotropic viruses.
abstract: Neurotropic viruses induce behavioral and cognitive alterations through diverse molecular and cellular mechanisms that extend beyond simple neuronal damage. Comparative analysis of rabies virus (RABV), pseudorabies virus (PRV), Borna disease virus (BoDV-1), SARS-CoV-2, Nipah virus (NiV), West Nile virus (WNV) and Herpes Simplex virus 1 (HSV-1) reveals distinct pathogenic strategies targeting specific neural circuits. While neuroinflammation characterized by microglial activation, astrocytic responses, and pro-inflammatory cytokine production contributes significantly to synaptic and network dysfunction in WNV and NiV infections, other mechanisms predominate in different pathogens. RABV selectively disrupts cholinergic, serotonergic, and glutamate/GABAergic pathways while preserving neuronal integrity to facilitate transmission, whereas BoDV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 induce dopaminergic and serotonergic dysfunctions through persistent immune activation and endothelial damage. Additionally, systemic factors such as the gut-brain axis and microbiome alterations, particularly evident in SARS-CoV-2 infection, modulate neurotransmitter metabolism and neuroimmune responses. Considering the lack of even diffuse neuronal loss observed during infection, behavioral changes may arise more from selective, circuit-dependent vulnerabilities, involving specific disruptions to emotion, cognition, and motor control networks. To provide a clear review of the knowledge regarding how targeted neuronal population alterations translate into behavioral phenotypes, we here integrate molecular, cellular, and systems-level insights across these seven neurotropic viruses used as models, with the aim of identifying common pathways linking infection to behavioral changes and cognitive dysfunction. Understanding these discrete mechanisms ranging from acute synaptic manipulation to long-lasting neuroimmune dysregulation is essential for developing therapeutic strategies that address both the infectious agent and the specific neural networks mediating acute disturbances and long-term neurological sequelae.

abstract_zh: 嗜神经病毒通过多种分子和细胞机制诱导行为和认知改变,其范围超出了简单的神经元损伤。对 狂犬病病毒 (RABV)、伪狂犬病病毒 (PRV)、博尔纳病病毒 (BoDV-1)、SARS-CoV-2、尼帕病毒 (NiV)、西尼罗河病毒 (WNV) 和单纯疱疹病毒 1 (HSV-1) 的比较分析揭示了针对特定神经回路的不同致病策略。虽然以小胶质细胞激活、星形细胞反应和促炎细胞因子产生为特征的神经炎症在 WNV 和 NiV 感染中导致突触和网络功能障碍,但其他机制在不同病原体中占主导地位。RABV 选择性破坏胆碱能、血清素能和谷氨酸/GABA 能途径,同时保留神经元完整性以促进 传播,而 BoDV-1 和 SARS-CoV-2 通过持续的免疫激活和内皮损伤诱导多巴胺能和血清素能功能障碍。此外,肠脑轴和微生物组改变等全身因素(在 SARS-CoV-2 感染中尤其明显)可调节神经递质代谢和神经免疫反应。考虑到在感染过程中观察到的甚至弥漫性神经元损失的情况,行为变化可能更多地是由选择性的、依赖于回路的脆弱性引起的,涉及对情绪、认知和运动控制网络的特定破坏。为了清楚地回顾有关靶向神经元群体改变如何转化为行为表型的知识,我们在这里整合了用作模型的这七种嗜神经病毒的分子、细胞和系统级见解,目的是确定将感染与行为变化和认知功能障碍联系起来的常见途径。了解从急性突触操纵到长期神经免疫失调的这些离散机制对于制定针对感染因子和介导急性紊乱和长期神经后遗症的特定神经网络的治疗策略至关重要。

title: Future vaccine priorities in Cambodia: preparedness for emerging infectious diseases.
abstract: Cambodia has achieved substantial progress in immunisation over the past two decades, culminating in one of Southeast Asia's most successful COVID-19 vaccination campaigns. However, the epidemiological landscape is rapidly changing. Climate change, environmental degradation, urbanisation, increasing regional mobility, and intensified human-animal interactions are increasing the risk of emerging infectious diseases, placing Cambodia at the frontline of future epidemic and pandemic threats. Although national vaccine policy has traditionally focused on childhood immunisation, preparedness for emerging infectious diseases requires a broader strategy that integrates pathogen surveillance, genomic monitoring, regulatory readiness, rapid vaccine platforms, and One Health collaboration. Here, we highlight the need for Cambodia to transition from a vaccine delivery agenda toward a broader vaccine preparedness agenda. We propose a national framework centred around surveillance-informed vaccine prioritisation, strengthened laboratory and genomic capacity, resilient vaccine delivery systems, sustainable financing, and regional partnerships. Such an approach could enhance Cambodia's preparedness for pathogens including H5N1, dengue, Japanese encephalitis, rabies, and future Disease X scenarios, while strengthening its contribution to regional health security.

Climate change, environmental degradation, urbanisation, increasing regional mobility, and intensified human-animal interactions are increasing the risk of emerging infectious diseases, placing Cambodia at the frontline of future epidemic and pandemic threats. Although national vaccine policy has traditionally focused on childhood immunisation, preparedness for emerging infectious diseases requires a broader strategy that integrates pathogen surveillance, genomic monitoring, regulatory readiness, rapid vaccine platforms, and One Health collaboration. We propose a national framework centred around surveillance-informed vaccine prioritisation, strengthened laboratory and genomic capacity, resilient vaccine delivery systems, sustainable financing, and regional partnerships. Such an approach could enhance Cambodia's preparedness for pathogens including H5N1, dengue, Japanese encephalitis, rabies, and future Disease X scenarios, while strengthening its contribution to regional health security.

title: Infectious Disease Diagnostic Capacity Across Hospital Tiers in China: National Cross-Sectional Survey.
abstract: BACKGROUND: China's notifiable infectious disease surveillance relies on clinical recognition and diagnostic testing, but uneven hospital capacity may affect case ascertainment and interpretation of reported burden. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to assess infectious disease diagnostic capacity across hospital tiers in China, including alignment with notified disease burden, regional variation, diagnostic modalities, and implementation barriers. METHODS: We conducted a national cross-sectional web-based survey of hospitals in China in 2023. After centralized quality control and eligibility screening, 2689 hospitals were included: 124 (4.6%) primary, 1478 (55%) secondary, and 1087 (40.4%) tertiary hospitals. We assessed in-house and send-out testing availability; compared diagnostic availability with national notified incidence and mortality; and examined regional variation, selected diagnostic modalities, and reported barriers. RESULTS: Median in-house diagnostic coverage increased from 11.6% (IQR 9.3%-18.6%) in primary hospitals to 27.9% (IQR 18.6%-37.2%) in secondary hospitals and 39.5% (IQR 27.9%-48.8%) in tertiary hospitals; corresponding overall coverage, including send-out testing, was 14% (IQR 9.3%-23.3%), 32.6% (IQR 23.3%-44.2%), and 44.2% (IQR 30.2%-55.8%), respectively. Tier differences persisted in sensitivity analyses. Diagnostic availability was not consistently aligned with notified disease burden. In-house hepatitis B testing was available in 82.3% (102/124), 98% (1449/1478), and 99.3% (1079/1087) of primary, secondary, and tertiary hospitals, respectively. Pulmonary tuberculosis showed a pronounced tier gradient (26/124, 21% in primary vs 910/1087, 83.7% in tertiary hospitals). Hand, foot, and mouth disease and other infectious diarrheal diseases had limited availability even in tertiary hospitals (380/1087, 35% and 456/1087, 42%, respectively) despite high incidence. Some lower-incidence but high-consequence infections also had limited local capacity, including hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (151/1087, 13.9%) and rabies (43/1087, 4%) in tertiary hospitals. Geographic variation was partly consistent with known disease endemicity, with higher testing availability for hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome in northeastern hospitals, although only 35.9% (55/153) of tertiary hospitals in this region offered in-house testing. Diagnostic depth also varied across tiers: hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA testing increased from 8.1% (10/124) in primary hospitals to 61.1% (664/1087) in tertiary hospitals. For COVID-19, primary hospitals more frequently reported antigen than nucleic acid testing (57/124, 46% vs 27/124, 21.8%). Lower-tier hospitals more often reported workforce and infrastructure constraints, whereas tertiary hospitals more frequently cited reagent-licensing and fee-schedule barriers. CONCLUSIONS: Among surveyed hospitals, infectious disease diagnostic capacity differed substantially across hospital tiers, varied geographically, and was not consistently aligned with notified disease burden. These disparities extended beyond disease coverage to specific testing modalities and barriers to capacity expansion. These findings support tiered, regionally responsive diagnostic networks that provide essential testing closer to first-contact care while ensuring timely access to specialized diagnostics through reliable, quality-assured referral pathways.

Methods We conducted a national cross-sectional web-based survey of hospitals in China in 2023. After centralized quality control and eligibility screening, 2689 hospitals were included: 124 (4.6%) primary, 1478 (55%) secondary, and 1087 (40.4%) tertiary hospitals. We assessed in-house and send-out testing availability; compared diagnostic availability with national notified incidence and mortality; and examined regional variation, selected diagnostic modalities, and reported barriers. Results Median in-house diagnostic coverage increased from 11.6% (IQR 9.3%-18.6%) in primary hospitals to 27.9% (IQR 18.6%-37.2%) in secondary hospitals and 39.5% (IQR 27.9%-48.8%) in tertiary hospitals; corresponding overall coverage, including send-out testing, was 14% (IQR 9.3%-23.3%), 32.6% (IQR 23.3%-44.2%), and 44.2% (IQR 30.2%-55.8%), respectively. In-house hepatitis B testing was available in 82.3% (102/124), 98% (1449/1478), and 99.3% (1079/1087) of primary, secondary, and tertiary hospitals, respectively. Lower-tier hospitals more often reported workforce and infrastructure constraints, whereas tertiary hospitals more frequently cited reagent-licensing and fee-schedule barriers. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年对中国2689家医院进行了全国横断面网络调查,其中一级医院124家,二级医院1478家,三级医院1087家。
elements_zh.methods: 该调查涉及集中质量控制和资格筛选、评估内部和发送测试的可用性、诊断方式和实施障碍。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究发现,不同级别医院的诊断能力存在显着差异,差异不仅限于疾病覆盖范围,还包括特定的检测方式以及能力扩张的障碍。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持分层的、区域响应的诊断网络,该网络提供更接近首次接触护理的基本测试,同时确保通过可靠、有质量保证的转诊途径及时获得专业诊断。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性,包括对自我报告数据的依赖和潜在的报告偏差,可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。证据强度中等。

title: Comparing NGO and government-managed dog vaccination: Implications for vaccination coverage and rabies outcomes in animals and humans in Meru, Tanzania
abstract: Background : Rabies is a fatal but preventable zoonotic disease transmitted primarily by domestic dogs. Mass dog vaccination (MDV) is central to rabies elimination, yet vaccination coverage in endemic settings often remains insufficient and uneven. This study assessed dog vaccination coverage under two contrasting delivery arrangements in Meru, Tanzania: Organised, non-government (NGO)-managed annual MDV campaigns and predominantly owner-initiated vaccination services in government-managed wards. It also examined human rabies exposures and animal rabies cases and identified barriers and facilitators affecting vaccination delivery. Methods : Vaccination data from NGO-managed MDV campaigns (2020–2024) were obtained from Mbwa wa Africa records, and 2025 data were collected during campaign implementation. Vaccination coverage in both NGO and government-managed wards was estimated using household surveys conducted after NGO-managed campaigns and in government-managed wards where no organised annual MDV campaigns were implemented. Data on human exposures and suspected animal cases (2023–2025) were extracted from the Integrated Bite Case Management System. Generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs) were used to compare vaccination coverage between the two settings and to assess the association among vaccination coverage, human exposures, and animal cases. Qualitative interviews were conducted to explore barriers to and facilitators of MDV. Results : Vaccination coverage in NGO-managed wards increased from 45.1% in 2020 to 71% in 2025, while government-managed wards remained low, peaking at 21.9% in 2023 before declining to 8.8% in 2025. GLMM analysis confirmed higher vaccination coverage in NGO-managed wards (IRR = 12.1, 95% CI: 12.1–12.2; p < 0.05). Human exposures and animal cases declined in 2024 but increased in 2025. Animal rabies cases were associated with human exposures. Vaccination coverage was not associated with human exposures (IRR = 1.0, 95% CI: 0.998–1.010, p = 0.730) but was associated with animal cases (IRR =1.02, 95% CI: 1.01–1.04, p = 0.008). Barriers included limited veterinary outreach, vaccination fees, dog handling difficulties, low awareness, and free-roaming dogs. Facilitators included decentralised delivery, free services, and community mobilisation. Conclusion : Organised NGO-managed campaigns were associated with higher vaccination coverage than the predominantly owner-initiated vaccination services available in government-managed wards. However, uneven spatial coverage remained a challenge for district-wide rabies control. The findings highlight the importance of accessible, coordinated, and equitable dog vaccination services integrated with One Health surveillance. One Health impact statement Rabies remains a One Health challenge at the human-animal interface. This study demonstrates that fragmented vaccination delivery and uneven spatial coverage undermine ward-level rabies control, even where high coverage is achieved locally. By integrating mass dog vaccination data with Integrated Bite Case Management (IBCM) surveillance data, we show how disparities in animal health service delivery directly translate into human rabies exposure risk. Importantly, the IBCM datasets analysed in this study were developed through routine cross-sector collaboration between the human health and animal health sectors, illustrating the practical application of the One Health approach in rabies surveillance. The findings provide evidence that coordinated, cross-sectoral planning – linking veterinary vaccination campaigns, human health surveillance, and community engagement – is essential to achieve and sustain elimination targets. This work illustrates how aligning NGO and government strategies within a unified One Health framework can strengthen policy implementation, improve equity in service delivery, and accelerate progress toward “Zero by 30” targets.

It also examined human rabies exposures and animal rabies cases and identified barriers and facilitators affecting vaccination delivery. Methods : Vaccination data from NGO-managed MDV campaigns (2020–2024) were obtained from Mbwa wa Africa records, and 2025 data were collected during campaign implementation. Data on human exposures and suspected animal cases (2023–2025) were extracted from the Integrated Bite Case Management System. Generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs) were used to compare vaccination coverage between the two settings and to assess the association among vaccination coverage, human exposures, and animal cases. Qualitative interviews were conducted to explore barriers to and facilitators of MDV. Results : Vaccination coverage in NGO-managed wards increased from 45.1% in 2020 to 71% in 2025, while government-managed wards remained low, peaking at 21.9% in 2023 before declining to 8.8% in 2025. Animal rabies cases were associated with human exposures. Vaccination coverage was not associated with human exposures (IRR = 1.0, 95% CI: 0.998–1.010, p = 0.730) but was associated with animal cases (IRR =1.02, 95% CI: 1.01–1.04, p = 0.008). Barriers included limited veterinary outreach, vaccination fees, dog handling difficulties, low awareness, and free-roaming dogs. Facilitators included decentralised delivery, free services, and community mobilisation. Conclusion : Organised NGO-managed campaigns were associated with higher vaccination coverage than the predominantly owner-initiated vaccination services available in government-managed wards. However, uneven spatial coverage remained a challenge for district-wide rabies control. The findings highlight the importance of accessible, coordinated, and equitable dog vaccination services integrated with One Health surveillance. This study demonstrates that fragmented vaccination delivery and uneven spatial coverage undermine ward-level rabies control, even where high coverage is achieved locally. By integrating mass dog vaccination data with Integrated Bite Case Management (IBCM) surveillance data, we show how disparities in animal health service delivery directly translate into human rabies exposure risk. Importantly, the IBCM datasets analysed in this study were developed through routine cross-sector collaboration between the human health and animal health sectors, illustrating the practical application of the One Health approach in rabies surveillance. The findings provide evidence that coordinated, cross-sectoral planning – linking veterinary vaccination campaigns, human health surveillance, and community engagement – is essential to achieve and sustain elimination targets. title: RVG29-modified reduction-responsive nanomicelles for brain-targeted delivery of a glutaminyl cyclase inhibitor in Alzheimer's disease.
abstract: Although glutaminyl cyclase (QC)-mediated formation of pyroglutamate-modified amyloid-β (pE-Aβ) has been implicated as an upstream pathological event in Alzheimer's disease (AD), the therapeutic translation of small-molecule QC inhibitors remains limited by insufficient brain exposure. Here, we developed a reduction-responsive polymeric micellar platform (designated PIC) based on poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG)-poly(aspartic acid) (PAsp)-poly(valine) (PVal) copolymers. This platform was functionalized with rabies virus glycoprotein-derived peptide 29 (RVG29) to obtain RVG29-PIC-B13 for enhanced brain delivery of B13, an imidazole-based QC inhibitor, and release of its active thiol form. B13 was conjugated to PEG-PAsp-PVal micelles through a disulfide linker, whereas RVG29 was introduced as a brain-targeting ligand to enhance blood-brain barrier transport. RVG29-PIC-B13 formed spherical nanomicelles with an average diameter of 169.9 nm, a drug-loading content of 6.2%, high colloidal stability, and glutathione-triggered release of B13-SH, which retained QC inhibitory activity with an IC 50 of 1.17 μM. RVG29 modification significantly enhanced cellular uptake in bEND.3, PC12, and SH-SY5Y cells, increased transport across a bEND.3 monolayer by 3.12-fold, and elevated brain fluorescence accumulation in vivo by 2.58-fold and 1.96-fold compared with free Cy5 and unmodified micelles, respectively. In 8-month-old 3 × Tg-AD mice, 45-day administration of RVG29-PIC-B13 significantly improved performance in the Morris water maze, Y-maze, open-field, and elevated plus maze assays. Mechanistically, RVG29-PIC-B13 inhibited brain QC activity without markedly altering QC expression, reduced Aβ and pE-Aβ burden, attenuated AT8/AT100-associated tau phosphorylation, and preserved dendritic complexity and spine density. Preliminary hematological and histological analyses indicated acceptable biocompatibility. These findings support RVG29-PIC-B13 as a promising reduction-responsive nanodelivery strategy for enhancing brain delivery of QC inhibitors and improving therapeutic outcomes in AD.

abstract_zh: 尽管谷氨酰胺酰环化酶 (QC) 介导的焦谷氨酸修饰的淀粉样蛋白 -β (pE-Aβ) 的形成被认为是阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 的上游病理事件,但小分子 QC 抑制剂的治疗转化仍然受到大脑暴露不足的限制。在这里,我们开发了一种基于聚乙二醇(PEG)-聚(天冬氨酸)(PAsp)-聚(缬氨酸)(PVal)共聚物的还原响应聚合物胶束平台(指定为PIC)。该平台使用 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白衍生肽 29 (RVG29) 进行功能化,以获得 RVG29-PIC-B13,用于增强 B13(一种基于咪唑的 QC 抑制剂)的脑部递送,并释放其活性硫醇形式。B13 通过二硫键与 PEG-PAsp-PVal 胶束缀合,而 RVG29 则作为脑靶向配体引入,以增强血脑屏障转运。RVG29-PIC-B13形成球形纳米胶束,平均直径为169.9 nm,载药量为6.2%,胶体稳定性高,谷胱甘肽触发释放B13-SH,保留了QC抑制活性,IC 50 为1.17 μM。与游离 Cy5 和未修饰的胶束相比,RVG29 修饰显着增强了 bEND.3、PC12 和 SH-SY5Y 细胞中的细胞摄取,使穿过 bEND.3 单层的转运增加了 3.12 倍,并使体内脑荧光积累分别增加了 2.58 倍和 1.96 倍。在 8 个月大的 3 × Tg-AD 小鼠中,RVG29-PIC-B13 给药 45 天显着改善了 Morris 水迷宫、Y 迷宫、开放场和高架十字迷宫测定的性能。从机制上讲,RVG29-PIC-B13 抑制大脑 QC 活性,但不显着改变 QC 表达,减少 Aβ 和 pE-Aβ 负担,减弱 AT8/AT100 相关 tau 磷酸化,并保留树突复杂性和树突棘密度。初步的血液学和组织学分析表明具有可接受的生物相容性。这些发现支持 RVG29-PIC-B13 作为一种有前途的还原响应纳米递送策略,用于增强 QC 抑制剂的大脑递送并改善 AD 的治疗结果。

title: Seroprotection and improved polyfunctional immunity conferred by a YF17D-vectored rabies vaccine
abstract: ABSTRACT Rabies remains a major public-health challenge, with pre-exposure vaccination strategies constrained by the need for multiple doses and repeated healthcare visits. Here we describe YF-RabG, a live-attenuated rabies vaccine candidate based on the yellow fever 17D (YF17D) vaccine backbone that stably expresses the rabies virus glycoprotein (RabG). YF-RabG exhibited an attenuated phenotype and favourable safety profile compared with parental YF17D across several preclinical models, including neonatal and immunocompromised mice. A single immunization induced robust humoral and cell-mediated immune responses in non-human primates. Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titres readily exceeded the widely accepted correlate of protection in mice, hamsters and non-human primates by several orders. Accordingly, vaccination conferred protection against lethal rabies challenge in a range of stringent mouse models, maintained seroprotective antibody levels for at least one year, and increased following a boost using a licensed rabies vaccine. Furthermore, the YF17D vector was readily adapted to accommodate glycoproteins from distant lyssaviruses, generating protective vaccine candidates against Mokola, Lagos bat and Lleida bat lyssaviruses. Collectively, these findings identify YF-RabG as a promising single-dose rabies vaccine candidate and highlight the versatility of the YF17D platform for lyssavirus vaccine development.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces YF-RabG, a rabies vaccine candidate based on the yellow fever 17D (YF17D) vaccine backbone that expresses the rabies virus glycoprotein. The research highlights the need for improved rabies vaccination strategies due to the limitations of current multi-dose approaches. The study demonstrates that YF-RabG induces strong immune responses in non-human primates and provides protection against rabies challenge in mouse models. It also shows that the YF17D platform can be adapted to create vaccines against related lyssaviruses. The findings suggest YF-RabG as a potential single-dose vaccine candidate and emphasize the platform's versatility. The study's results are based on preclinical models, which may limit their direct applicability to human populations. The evidence is strong for the vaccine's efficacy in these models, but further human trials are needed to confirm its effectiveness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 仍然是一个重大的公共卫生挑战,暴露前 狂犬病 策略受到多次剂量和重复医疗就诊的需要的限制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这里,我们描述了 YF-RabG,一种基于黄热病 17D (YF17D) 疫苗 主链的减毒活 狂犬病 疫苗 候选药物,可稳定表达 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白 (RabG)。
elements_zh.methods: 因此,疫苗接种 在一系列严格的小鼠模型中提供针对致命 狂犬病 挑战的保护,维持血清保护抗体水平至少一年,并在使用许可的 狂犬病 疫苗 加强后增加。
elements_zh.main_results: 单次免疫在非人灵长类动物中诱导了强大的体液和细胞介导的 免疫应答。

title_zh: YF17D 载体 狂犬病 疫苗 赋予血清保护和改善的多功能免疫力
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Rabies remains a major public-health challenge, with pre-exposure vaccination strategies constrained by the need for multiple doses and repeated healthcare visits. Here we describe YF-RabG, a live-attenuated rabies vaccine candidate based on the yellow fever 17D (YF17D) vaccine backbone that stably expresses the rabies virus glycoprotein (RabG). YF-RabG exhibited an attenuated phenotype and favourable safety profile compared with parental YF17D across several preclinical models, including neonatal and immunocompromised mice. A single immunization induced robust humoral and cell-mediated immune responses in non-human primates. Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titres readily exceeded the widely accepted correlate of protection in mice, hamsters and non-human primates by several orders. Accordingly, vaccination conferred protection against lethal rabies challenge in a range of stringent mouse models, maintained seroprotective antibody levels for at least one year, and increased following a boost using a licensed rabies vaccine. Furthermore, the YF17D vector was readily adapted to accommodate glycoproteins from distant lyssaviruses, generating protective vaccine candidates against Mokola, Lagos bat and Lleida bat lyssaviruses. Collectively, these findings identify YF-RabG as a promising single-dose rabies vaccine candidate and highlight the versatility of the YF17D platform for lyssavirus vaccine development.
abstract_zh: 摘要 狂犬病 仍然是一个重大的公共卫生挑战,暴露前 狂犬病 策略因需要多次剂量和重复医疗就诊而受到限制。在这里,我们描述了 YF-RabG,一种基于黄热病 17D (YF17D) 疫苗 主链的减毒活 狂犬病 疫苗 候选药物,可稳定表达 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白 (RabG)。在多种临床前模型(包括新生小鼠和免疫功能低下小鼠)中,与亲本 YF17D 相比,YF-RabG 表现出减弱的表型和良好的安全性。单次免疫在非人灵长类动物中诱导了强大的体液和细胞介导的 免疫应答。狂犬病病毒 中和抗体滴度很容易超过小鼠、仓鼠和非人类灵长类动物中广泛接受的保护相关性几个数量级。因此,疫苗接种 在一系列严格的小鼠模型中提供针对致命 狂犬病 挑战的保护,维持血清保护抗体水平至少一年,并在使用许可的 狂犬病 疫苗 加强后增加。此外,YF17D 媒介 很容易适应来自远缘狂犬病病毒的糖蛋白,产生针对 Mokola、Lagos 蝙蝠和 Lleida 蝙蝠狂犬病病毒的保护性 疫苗 候选病毒。总的来说,这些发现将 YF-RabG 确定为一种有前途的单剂量 狂犬病 疫苗 候选药物,并强调了 YF17D 平台用于狂犬病病毒 疫苗 开发的多功能性。

title: Evaluation of all three pinniped families to triannual vaccination with an inactivated rabies vaccine
abstract: A recent outbreak of rabies virus has been identified as an emerging epidemic among Cape fur seals ( Arctocephalus pusillus pusillus ) along the southern African coastline. This marks the first large-scale detection of rabies virus in marine mammals and raises significant concerns about potential transmission to other mammals and humans. There is also growing apprehension about the virus’s capacity to spread across national and continental borders, with a potential spillover event occurring into the sub-Antarctic region. Vaccination of wild populations would be a cornerstone to controlling this outbreak. This study investigated whether pinnipeds housed at Ocean Park Corporation (OPC) in Hong Kong developed an immune response to a commercially available inactivated rabies vaccine (Rabisin ® and Nobivac ® ). Sixteen pinnipeds, representing all three pinniped family groups including Californian sea lion ( Zalophus californianus ), Pacific walrus ( Odobenus rosmarus ), Harbor seal ( Phoca vitulina ), and Spotted seal ( Phoca largha ), received a 1 mL dose of an inactivated parenteral vaccine every three years. Historical serum samples collected over five years during routine health examinations were analyzed to assess the duration of the vaccine-induced immune response. The antibody titers indicated that all individuals seroconverted and remained seropositive following vaccination. Although antibody titers declined before administration of the second vaccine dose at the three-year interval, all recorded values remained above the 0.5 IU/L threshold considered indicative of an adequate (presumed protective) immune response to rabies vaccination. The study concluded that the parenteral vaccine was safe for use across all three pinniped families in the species studied and that a single dose provided protective immunity for approximately three years, after which booster vaccination was recommended.

title: Association between socioeconomic factors and rabies-related knowledge, attitudes and practices among dog owners in Mungwi District, Zambia
abstract: Rabies remains an important public health concern in many low- and middle-income countries, including Zambia, where domestic dogs are the principal source of human rabies transmission. This study assessed the association between socioeconomic characteristics and rabies-related knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices among registered dog owners in selected high-risk communities of Mungwi District, Zambia. An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among 162 registered dog owners using a pretested structured questionnaire administered through face-to-face interviews. Descriptive statistics and multivariable linear regression analyses were used to assess associations between socioeconomic characteristics and knowledge, attitude, practice, and overall KAP scores. Of the 162 respondents, 60.5% had high knowledge, 39.5% had favourable attitudes, and 26.5% reported desirable preventive practices. Most respondents correctly identified dog bites as the principal route of rabies transmission and recognised dog vaccination as an important preventive measure. However, participation in community rabies-control activities remained limited, and some respondents reported reliance on traditional treatment following dog bites. Multivariable analyses showed domain-specific associations. Higher education was associated with higher knowledge, attitude, and overall KAP scores, while higher income was associated with higher knowledge, attitude, practice, and overall KAP scores. Employment status was negatively associated with knowledge but positively associated with attitude and overall KAP scores, and was not significantly associated with preventive-practice scores after adjustment. Residence type was associated with knowledge, preventive practices, and overall KAP, with rural respondents having lower knowledge scores and both rural and peri-urban respondents having lower preventive-practice and overall KAP scores than urban respondents. Socioeconomic and geographic characteristics were differentially associated with rabies-related KAP among registered dog owners in the selected high-risk communities. The findings indicate that favourable knowledge and attitudes did not consistently correspond with desirable preventive practices, particularly among rural and lower-income respondents. These findings may inform targeted rabies-prevention strategies, while the cross-sectional design means that the observed associations should not be interpreted as causal.

abstract_zh: 狂犬病 仍然是许多低收入和中等收入国家的重要公共卫生问题,其中包括赞比亚,家犬是人类 狂犬病 传播 的主要来源。本研究评估了赞比亚 Mungwi 区选定高风险社区的注册狗主人的社会经济特征与 狂犬病 相关知识、态度和预防措施之间的关联。一项分析性横断面研究在 162 名注册狗主人中进行,使用预先测试的结构化问卷,通过面对面访谈进行。使用描述性统计和多变量线性回归分析来评估社会经济特征与知识、态度、实践和整体 KAP 分数之间的关联。在 162 名受访者中,60.5% 的人有较高的知识,39.5% 的人有良好的态度,26.5% 的人表示有良好的预防措施。大多数受访者正确地将狗咬伤视为 狂犬病 传播 的主要途径,并将狗 疫苗接种 视为重要的预防措施。然而,对社区 狂犬病 控制活动的参与仍然有限,一些受访者报告说,在被狗咬伤后,他们依赖传统的 狂犬病。多变量分析显示了特定领域的关联。高等教育与较高的知识、态度和整体 KAP 得分相关,而较高的收入则与较高的知识、态度、实践和整体 KAP 得分相关。就业状况与知识呈负相关,但与态度和总体 KAP 得分呈正相关,并且与调整后的预防实践得分不显着相关。居住地类型与知识、预防实践和总体 KAP 相关,农村受访者的知识得分较低,农村和城郊受访者的预防实践和总体 KAP 得分均低于城市受访者。在选定的高风险社区中注册的狗主人中,社会经济和地理特征与 狂犬病 相关 KAP 存在差异相关。研究结果表明,良好的知识和态度并不总是符合理想的预防措施,特别是在农村和低收入受访者中。这些发现可能会为有针对性的 狂犬病 预防策略提供信息,而横截面设计意味着观察到的关联不应被解释为因果关系。

title: Evaluation of integrated community-based surveillance within the 4S network in Senegal: implications for early detection of epidemic and zoonotic events
abstract: Abstract Background Community-based surveillance integrated into the 4S network (Syndromic Surveillance System in Senegal) is an innovative approach designed to strengthen the early detection and reporting of diseases with epidemic potential, zoonoses, and unusual events through the active involvement of community stakeholders. Piloted in Senegal across three sites, Darou Salam (Pikine), Agnam Civol (Matam), and Dalaba (Kédougou), this strategy has proven its effectiveness in mobilizing community actors, complementing existing health systems, and detecting human and animal health events. Method The evaluation combined quantitative surveys of 83 community stakeholders and healthcare professionals with qualitative research comprising 44 semi-structured interviews and 9 focus groups. A descriptive analysis was conducted on the collected quantitative data and the database of alerts issued by community stakeholders. A thematic analysis was conducted on the qualitative data to contextualize the quantitative results. Results The results show strong community engagement, a revitalisation of the Integrated Community Surveillance and Alert Committees (CVAC.i), and improved detection of health indicators, including maternal deaths, suspected measles, rabies, and haemorrhagic fevers. The system facilitated the reporting of 179 alerts during the evaluation period, of which 88.3% were verified by healthcare professionals. However, logistical, human, digital, and financial constraints persist, raising questions about the model’s large-scale feasibility and longer-term sustainability. Conclusion The Community-based surveillance in Senegal illustrates the importance of a participatory, cross-sectoral approach to strengthening health system resilience. Its long-term sustainability will depend on innovative funding mechanisms, the formalization of the CVACs’ role, and sustainable cross-sectoral collaboration.

A descriptive analysis was conducted on the collected quantitative data and the database of alerts issued by community stakeholders. A thematic analysis was conducted on the qualitative data to contextualize the quantitative results. Results The results show strong community engagement, a revitalisation of the Integrated Community Surveillance and Alert Committees (CVAC.i), and improved detection of health indicators, including maternal deaths, suspected measles, rabies, and haemorrhagic fevers. The system facilitated the reporting of 179 alerts during the evaluation period, of which 88.3% were verified by healthcare professionals. However, logistical, human, digital, and financial constraints persist, raising questions about the model’s large-scale feasibility and longer-term sustainability. Conclusion The Community-based surveillance in Senegal illustrates the importance of a participatory, cross-sectoral approach to strengthening health system resilience. Its long-term sustainability will depend on innovative funding mechanisms, the formalization of the CVACs’ role, and sustainable cross-sectoral collaboration.

title: Epidemiological pattern and distribution of animal-bite cases presenting to a tertiary anti-rabies clinic in Kashmir valley: a retrospective record-based study
abstract: Rabies remains a critical public health issue globally, particularly in India where high mortality rates and socio-economic impacts persist. Despite effective post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), cases often go unreported or poorly managed due to underreporting and limited healthcare access. In the Kashmir region of Jammu & Kashmir, there has been a notable increase in dog bites, but data on other types of animal bites and trends is limited. This study aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of animal bite incidents in the Kashmir Valley, including the types of animals involved, the sites of exposure, and the severity of injuries. The research seeks to address data gaps and underreporting issues to improve public health responses and preventive measures. A retrospective record based study was conducted using data from the Anti-Rabies Clinic (ARC) at Shri Maharaja Hari Singh (SMHS) Hospital, Srinagar, for the year 2023. Data was hand-copied and transcribed into Microsoft Excel 2021 for analysis. Descriptive statistical techniques were used to assess demographic trends, clinic-attending animal-bite case, and characteristics of animal bites. The study recorded 8,269 animal bite cases, with a predominance of males (73.12%) and adults aged 25–54 years (60.23%). Dogs were the most frequent source of bites (5,512 cases), followed by cats (2,318 cases). The majority of bites were on the lower limbs (4,758 cases), with Category 3 injuries being the most common (72.58%). The study demonstrates a substantial burden of animal bites in the Kashmir Valley, with dogs being the predominant source and Category III injuries representing the majority of exposures.. Effective measures should include regular stray dog population control through capture and sterilization programs, community education on avoiding stray dogs, enhanced vaccination initiatives for stray populations, and improved waste management to reduce stray dog attraction.

title: Visualization and Morphological Analysis of Individual Oligodendrocytes in the Mouse White Matter.
abstract: Myelin formation by oligodendrocytes is essential for the regulation of the conduction velocity and proper brain function. To ensure accurate information processing in response to experiences such as sensory stimuli and learning, oligodendrocytes adjust their number and morphology. In addition, oligodendrocyte morphology changes with senescence and in the presence of neurodegenerative diseases. Thus, visualizing oligodendrocytes and analyzing their morphology is crucial for understanding how our brains change under such conditions. Herein, we describe the methods for labeling and analyzing the morphologies of individual oligodendrocytes in mouse white matter at the light microscopic level. PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP and PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP mice enable us to visualize and analyze later-born or early-born oligodendrocyte morphology. In addition, sparse oligodendrocyte labeling with attenuated rabies virus expressing GFP enables the visualization and morphological analysis of individual oligodendrocytes in various brain white matter regions without the need for transgenic animals. Furthermore, the combination with immunostaining in thick tissues enables the identification of labeled oligodendrocytes and myelin sheaths, as well as their interactions with neuronal axons. These methods are suitable for revealing how oligodendrocytes adapt their morphologies depending on environmental stimuli or pathological conditions.

abstract_zh: 少突胶质细胞形成髓鞘对于调节传导速度和维持正常脑功能至关重要。为了确保对如感觉刺激和学习等经验的准确信息处理,少突胶质细胞会调整其数量和形态。此外,少突胶质细胞的形态也会随着衰老和神经退行性疾病的发生而发生变化。因此,对少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析对于理解我们的大脑在这些条件下的变化至关重要。本文描述了在光学显微镜水平上对小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞进行标记和形态学分析的方法。PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP和PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP小鼠使我们能够可视化和分析晚期出生或早期出生的少突胶质细胞的形态。此外,使用减弱的狂犬病病毒表达GFP的稀疏少突胶质细胞标记方法,可以在无需转基因动物的情况下,对各种脑白质区域中的单个少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析。此外,与厚组织免疫染色相结合,可以识别标记的少突胶质细胞和髓鞘,以及它们与神经元轴突的相互作用。这些方法适用于揭示少突胶质细胞如何根据环境刺激或病理条件调整其形态。

analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究直接观察了在光学显微镜水平上可视化和分析小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞形态的能力。

title: Parvalbumin interneuron circuit sharpens orientation tuning via the extraclassical surround in cat V1
abstract: Parvalbumin-expressing (PV) inhibitory neurons are central to cortical gain control, yet optogenetic studies disagree on whether they sharpen orientation tuning or merely rescale responses. Because this work has been performed almost exclusively in rodents, which lack orientation columns and an orientation-matched extraclassical surround, the contribution of surround circuitry has remained untested. Here we combine cell-type-specific rabies-virus tracing with optogenetics to activate or suppress PV circuits in cat primary visual cortex, and measure single-neuron orientation tuning for stimuli confined to the classical receptive field or extending into the extraclassical surround. Activating PV circuits sharpened tuning progressively with illumination power for classical-receptive-field stimuli, but left tuning unchanged once the surround was engaged; conversely, suppressing them broadened tuning only for surround-engaging stimuli and left classical-receptive-field tuning unchanged. This double dissociation places PV circuitry in the causal path that sets tuning width and identifies surround suppression as the inhibition it supplies: where the surround is not recruited there is little PV-mediated inhibition to remove, and where it is, removing that inhibition widens tuning. PV-dependent sharpening is therefore bounded by the receptive-field architecture through which the population is recruited, not by a fixed property of the PV population itself.

The results showed that activating PV circuits progressively sharpened tuning for classical stimuli but had no effect on surround stimuli, while suppressing PV circuits broadened tuning only for surround stimuli. These findings suggest that PV circuitry is causally involved in setting tuning width, with surround suppression being the specific inhibition it provides. The study contributes to understanding the neural mechanisms underlying orientation tuning and may have implications for sensory processing research. However, the study is limited to cats, which may affect generalizability to other species.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究表达小清蛋白(PV)的抑制性神经元在皮质增益控制中的作用,特别是它们是否会增强方向调整或仅仅重新调整反应。背景强调,之前的光遗传学研究在这个问题上产生了相互矛盾的结果。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在猫的初级视觉皮层中进行,利用细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪结合光遗传学来激活或抑制 PV 回路。该研究的重点是测量仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激的单神经元方向调整。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及将细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪与光遗传学相结合,以操纵猫初级视觉皮层中的 PV 回路。针对仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激,测量单神经元方向调整。
elements_zh.main_results: 激活 PV 电路会逐渐锐化经典感受场刺激的方向调整,但一旦环绕声接合,调整就会保持不变。相反,抑制 PV 电路仅拓宽了对周围环境刺激的调谐,并且对经典感受野调谐没有影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PV 电路与设置调谐宽度有因果关系,而环绕抑制是它提供的特定抑制。这项研究引入了对 PV 神经元如何与感受野结构相互作用以影响方向调整的新理解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于理解视觉皮层定向调节的神经机制,这可能对研究神经系统疾病的感觉处理和潜在的治疗干预具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于猫,这可能会影响对其他物种的推广。证据是强有力的,因为它是基于相关模型系统中光伏电路的直接操作和测量。

abstract_zh: 表达小白蛋白(PV)的抑制性神经元是皮质增益控制的核心,但光遗传学研究对于它们是否会增强方向调节或仅仅重新调整反应存在分歧。由于这项工作几乎完全是在啮齿动物身上进行的,这些动物缺乏方向柱和方向匹配的超古典环绕声,因此环绕电路的贡献尚未经过测试。在这里,我们将细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪与光遗传学结合起来,激活或抑制猫初级视觉皮层中的 PV 回路,并测量单神经元方向调整,以限制经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围的刺激。激活 PV 电路会随着经典感受场刺激的照明功率逐渐锐化调谐,但一旦启用环绕声,调谐就会保持不变;相反,抑制它们只会扩大对周围环境刺激的调谐,并使经典感受野调谐保持不变。这种双重解离将 PV 电路置于因果路径中,该路径设置调谐宽度并将环绕声抑制识别为它提供的抑制:在没有招募环绕声的地方,几乎没有 PV 介导的抑制需要消除,而在有这种抑制的地方,消除该抑制会扩大调谐范围。因此,PV 相关的锐化受到招募群体的感受野架构的限制,而不是受到 PV 群体本身的固定属性的限制。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究表达小清蛋白(PV)的抑制性神经元在皮质增益控制中的作用,特别是它们是否会增强方向调整或仅仅重新调整反应。背景强调,之前的光遗传学研究在这个问题上产生了相互矛盾的结果。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在猫的初级视觉皮层中进行,利用细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪结合光遗传学来激活或抑制 PV 回路。该研究的重点是测量仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激的单神经元方向调整。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及将细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪与光遗传学相结合,以操纵猫初级视觉皮层中的 PV 回路。针对仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激,测量单神经元方向调整。
analysis_zh.main_results: 激活 PV 电路会逐渐锐化经典感受场刺激的方向调整,但一旦环绕声接合,调整就会保持不变。相反,抑制 PV 电路仅拓宽了对周围环境刺激的调谐,并且对经典感受野调谐没有影响。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PV 电路与设置调谐宽度有因果关系,而环绕抑制是它提供的特定抑制。这项研究引入了对 PV 神经元如何与感受野结构相互作用以影响方向调整的新理解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于理解视觉皮层定向调节的神经机制,这可能对研究神经系统疾病的感觉处理和潜在的治疗干预具有影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于猫,这可能会影响对其他物种的推广。证据是强有力的,因为它是基于相关模型系统中光伏电路的直接操作和测量。

title: Distribution of tetracycline-resistant phenotypes in Escherichia coli and Proteus mirabilis isolates from wildlife
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is increasingly recognized in wildlife, reflecting environmental exposure to antimicrobial agents. Among wild carnivores, red foxes (Vulpes vulpes) are considered useful sentinels for monitoring environmental dissemination of resistant bacteria. Escherichia coli and Proteus mirabilis are common intestinal commensals that can acquire and transfer resistance determinants. In Romania, oxytetracycline is included as a biomarker in oral anti-rabies vaccine baits distributed to fox populations, potentially contributing to the selection of resistant bacteria in these animals. This study aimed to evaluate the phenotypic resistance to tetracycline in E. mirabilis isolates recovered from wild red foxes in Romania and to assess the potential influence of environmental exposure to tetracyclines from anti-rabies vaccination baits. Thirty bacterial isolates, including twenty E. coli, respectively ten P. mirabilis strains, previously identified using the Vitek 2 Compact system were examined for tetracycline susceptibility using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method, according to standard interpretative criteria. coli isolates, 11 (55%) were resistant to tetracycline, while 9 (45%) were susceptible. mirabilis isolates (100%) exhibited resistance to tetracycline. These findings confirm the presence of tetracycline-resistant phenotypes among enteric bacteria from wild red foxes. The detection of tetracycline-resistant E. mirabilis in wild red foxes may reflect both intrinsic and environmentally influenced resistance, possibly linked to oxytetracycline exposure from vaccination baits. Ongoing antimicrobial resistance monitoring in wildlife supports the One Health approach to understanding environmental antimicrobial dissemination.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 野生动物中的抗菌素耐药性 (AMR) 越来越受到人们的重视,这反映了环境中抗菌剂的暴露情况。本研究旨在评估大肠杆菌对四环素的表型耐药性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在罗马尼亚,土霉素作为生物标志物被包含在分发给狐狸种群的口服抗 狂犬病 疫苗 诱饵中,可能有助于这些动物中耐药细菌的选择。三十种细菌分离株,其中二十种大肠杆菌。
elements_zh.methods: 根据标准解释标准,使用 Kirby-Bauer 纸片扩散法检查了先前使用 Vitek 2 Compact 系统鉴定的大肠杆菌和 10 株奇异变形杆菌菌株的四环素敏感性。
elements_zh.main_results: 大肠杆菌分离株中,11 株(55%)对四环素耐药,而 9 株(45%)敏感。奇异果分离株(100%)表现出对四环素的抗性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现证实了野生红狐肠道细菌中存在四环素抗性表型。耐四环素大肠杆菌的检测
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 野生红狐体内的奇异杆菌可能反映了内在和环境影响的抵抗力,可能与 疫苗接种 诱饵中的土霉素暴露有关。对野生动物持续进行的抗菌药物耐药性监测支持“同一个健康”方法来了解环境抗菌药物的传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告本研究的局限性或证据强度。

title: First detection of canine distemper virus infection in varie¬gated squirrels (Sciurus variegatoides) and porcupines (Coendou mexicanus) in Costa Rica
abstract: Canine distemper virus (CDV) is a multi-host pathogen capable of infecting a wide range of do-mestic and wild mammals, however, reports of infection in squirrels and porcupines remain scarce. As part of the wildlife rabies surveillance programme in Costa Rica, six wild mammals (four Sciurus variegatoides and two Coendou mexicanus) with neurological signs were evaluated to rule out rabies. All brain samples tested negative for rabies by direct immunofluorescence and RT-PCR. Rapid distemper antigen tests of ocular and nasal secretions were positive in both porcupines, which were subsequently euthanised. Advanced autolysis prevented histopathological evaluation in five of the animals; however, one squirrel showed severe neutrophilic pneumonia with necrosis and haemorrhage, a moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the pulmonary interstitium, intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies in bronchial epithelium, and a focal neutrophilic infiltrate in the midbrain. The findings were consistent with CDV infection accompanied by severe systemic bacterial infection. CDV was confirmed in two of the four squirrels and in the two porcupines by RT-PCR and sequencing. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that the Costa Rican sequences grouped into two distinct clusters: one containing both squirrels and another with both porcupines. All four sequences shared a common ancestor with CDV strains detected in domestic dogs in the United States (2012–2013), and more distantly with a dog strain from Argentina (2005). These cases represent one of the few documented occurrences of CDV in squirrels and porcupines worldwide and the first reported in Costa Rica, underscoring the need for continued molecular surveillance to clarify lineage dynamics and spillover pathways.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the first detection of canine distemper virus (CDV) in variegated squirrels and porcupines in Costa Rica. Six wild mammals with neurological signs were evaluated as part of a rabies surveillance program. Brain samples tested negative for rabies, but rapid distemper antigen tests were positive in both porcupines. One squirrel showed histopathological signs consistent with CDV infection. CDV was confirmed in two squirrels and both porcupines using RT-PCR and sequencing. Phylogenetic analysis revealed distinct clusters for the Costa Rican sequences. These findings emphasize the need for molecular surveillance to understand CDV dynamics and spillover in wildlife. The study provides moderate confidence due to the limited number of animals analyzed and the presence of advanced autolysis in most specimens.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 犬瘟热病毒(CDV)是一种多宿主病原体,能够感染多种家养和野生动物,然而,关于其在松鼠和豪猪中的感染报告仍然很少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 作为哥斯达黎加野生动物监测项目的一部分,对六只表现出神经系统症状的野生哺乳动物(四只Sciurus variegatoides和两只Coendou mexicanus)进行了评估以排除某种病原体。
elements_zh.methods: 所有脑组织样本通过直接免疫荧光和RT-PCR检测均未发现该病原体。通过RT-PCR和测序确认了其中两只松鼠和两只豪猪感染了CDV。
elements_zh.main_results: 对豪猪的结膜液和鼻分泌物进行的快速犬瘟热抗原检测呈阳性,随后这些豪猪被安乐死。五只动物因严重的自溶作用而无法进行组织病理学评估;然而,一只松鼠表现出严重的中性粒细胞性肺炎伴有坏死和出血,肺间质中有中度的淋巴浆细胞浸润,支气管上皮细胞中有胞浆内包涵体,中脑区域有局灶性中性粒细胞性浸润。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现与CDV感染伴随严重的系统性细菌感染一致。这些病例是全球少数记录的CDV在松鼠和豪猪中的感染案例之一,也是哥斯达黎加首次报告,强调了继续进行分子监测以明确病毒谱系动态和传播途径的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突显了分子监测在理解CDV谱系动态和传播途径中的重要性,这可以为疾病预防和控制的公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告研究的局限性,但这些发现得到了一种动物的分子确认和组织病理学分析的支持,表明结果具有中等程度的可信度。

title: “A STUDY TO ASSESS THE EFFECT OF A VIDEO ASSISTED TEACHING PROGRAMME ON KNOWLEDGE AND PRACTICE REGARDING DOG BITE MANAGEMENT AND RABIES PREVENTION AMONG PEOPLE IN SELECTED RURAL AREAS OF PUNE”.
abstract: Introduction: A dog bite is a bite upon a person or other animal by a dog. More than one successive bite is often called a dog attack, although dog attacks can include knock-downs and scratches. Though some dog bites do not result in injury, they can result in infection, disfigurement, temporary or permanent disability, or death. Another type of dog bite is the "soft bite" displayed by well-trained dogs, by puppies, and in non-aggressive play.1Title of the study: A study to assess the effect of a video assisted teaching Programme on knowledge and practice regarding dog bite management and rabies prevention among people in selected rural areas of Pune. Research Methodology: A pre-experimental one-group pretest post-test study was conducted among 100 adults in rural Pune to assess the effectiveness of a Video-Assisted Teaching Programme on knowledge and practice regarding dog bite management and rabies prevention. Data were collected using a structured tool and analyzed with descriptive and inferential statistics. The intervention improved participants’ knowledge and practices, with validated and reliable tools ensuring ethical compliance. Result: Among 100 participants (73% aged 18.1–30 years, 65% female, 46% graduates, 54% private job, 88% rural), pre-test knowledge and practice were poor in 71% (knowledge mean 6.6 ± 1.93; practice mean 3.62 ± 1.55). Post-test, 60% had good knowledge, 38% average, 2% poor (mean 14.2 ± 3.01), and 53% had good practice, 30% moderate, 17% poor (mean 7.05 ± 2.07). Improvements were statistically significant (knowledge t = 21.05, p = 0.00001; practice t = 14.29, p = 0.00001), with no significant association with demographics (p > 0.05). Conclusion: The study concluded that the Video-Assisted Teaching Programme was effective in improving knowledge and practice regarding dog bite management and rabies prevention among rural participants. Post-test scores showed significant improvement, while no significant association was found with demographic variables.
journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology

abstract_zh: 简介:狗咬伤是指狗咬伤人或其他动物。连续不止一次的咬伤通常被称为狗攻击,尽管狗的攻击可能包括击倒和抓伤。虽然有些狗咬伤不会造成伤害,但可能会导致感染、毁容、暂时或永久残疾或死亡。另一种类型的狗咬伤是训练有素的狗、小狗和非攻击性玩耍时表现出的“软咬合”。1 研究标题:一项研究评估视频辅助教学项目对浦那选定农村地区人们有关狗咬伤管理和 狂犬病 预防的知识和实践的影响。研究方法:在浦那农村地区的 100 名成年人中进行了一项实验前一组预测后测试研究,以评估视频辅助教学项目在狗咬伤管理和 狂犬病 预防方面的知识和实践的有效性。使用结构化工具收集数据,并使用描述性和推论性统计进行分析。该干预措施提高了参与者的知识和实践,并使用经过验证和可靠的工具确保道德合规性。结果:在 100 名参与者中(73% 年龄在 18.1-30 岁,65% 女性,46% 毕业生,54% 私人工作,88% 农村),71% 的人测试前知识和实践较差(知识平均值 6.6 ± 1.93;实践平均值 3.62 ± 1.55)。测试后,60% 的人知识良好,38% 为平均水平,2% 为差(平均 14.2 ± 3.01),53% 的人实践良好,30% 为中等,17% 为差(平均 7.05 ± 2.07)。改善具有统计显着性(知识 t = 21.05,p = 0.00001;实践 t = 14.29,p = 0.00001),与人口统计数据没有显着关联(p > 0.05)。结论:研究得出结论,视频辅助教学计划可有效提高农村参与者有关狗咬伤管理和 狂犬病 预防的知识和实践。测试后分数显示出显着改善,但与人口统计学变量没有发现显着关联。

title: Bioactive phytochemical extraction and characterisation from Solanum nigrum: an investigation of antirabies compounds using an in silico approach
abstract: The present study includes the phytochemical evaluation of Solanum nigrum methanol extract; 1.64 % (0.82 g), revealing an 80 % positive detection rate for major phytochemical tests. The column-eluted fractions obtained by methanol and hexane solvents were efficient in separating the compounds with a ratio of 3 : 7 and 2 : 8 respectively. The gas chromatography mass spectrometry study of the collected fractions showed the presence of 19 different compounds from a total of 30 peaks. Major compounds identified included 3,3-dimethylpiperidine, 3-methylhexan-2-amine, N-dl-Alanylglycine, (S)-(+)-1-cyclohexylethylamine, tetratriacontane, lauramide, piperazine, amino acids and their derivatives. A bioassay of the extract for 2,2-diphenyl-2-picryl hydrazyl scavenging showed concentration-dependent activity, recording a maximum of 68.041 % and anti-inflammatory activity of 67.4 % at 100 μg/mL. The 3D structural study of the targeted rabies virus glycoprotein revealed that the G-chain contained a cavity volume of 65.4 Å3 without any tunnels, implying a low transportability function. Chain A was found to have a relatively high pocket volume of 565.1 Å3 along with one or several tunnels, which indicates the existence of significant ligand binding sites. Docking against G-chain revealed that N-dl-Alanylglycine had the highest binding affinity with a docking score of −4.86 kcal/mol. On the other hand, docking against Chain A indicated that lauramide is the most effective compound among the two, with a docking score of −5.583 kcal/mol. The binding affinities of the selected molecules revealed that both could inhibit the binding capacity of the virus during infection. The current results indicate that the selection of candidates and the hypothesis supporting the effectiveness of phytocompounds against rabies might require additional exploration through in vivo research.

analysis.methods: The researchers used gas chromatography-mass spectrometry to analyze the extracted compounds and performed docking studies to assess their binding affinity with the rabies virus glycoprotein.

title_zh: 从龙葵中提取生物活性植物化学物质并进行表征:使用计算机方法研究抗狂犬病化合物
source_body_en: The present study includes the phytochemical evaluation of Solanum nigrum methanol extract; 1.64 % (0.82 g), revealing an 80 % positive detection rate for major phytochemical tests. The column-eluted fractions obtained by methanol and hexane solvents were efficient in separating the compounds with a ratio of 3 : 7 and 2 : 8 respectively. The gas chromatography mass spectrometry study of the collected fractions showed the presence of 19 different compounds from a total of 30 peaks. Major compounds identified included 3,3-dimethylpiperidine, 3-methylhexan-2-amine, N-dl-Alanylglycine, (S)-(+)-1-cyclohexylethylamine, tetratriacontane, lauramide, piperazine, amino acids and their derivatives. A bioassay of the extract for 2,2-diphenyl-2-picryl hydrazyl scavenging showed concentration-dependent activity, recording a maximum of 68.041 % and anti-inflammatory activity of 67.4 % at 100 μg/mL. The 3D structural study of the targeted rabies virus glycoprotein revealed that the G-chain contained a cavity volume of 65.4 Å3 without any tunnels, implying a low transportability function. Chain A was found to have a relatively high pocket volume of 565.1 Å3 along with one or several tunnels, which indicates the existence of significant ligand binding sites. Docking against G-chain revealed that N-dl-Alanylglycine had the highest binding affinity with a docking score of −4.86 kcal/mol. On the other hand, docking against Chain A indicated that lauramide is the most effective compound among the two, with a docking score of −5.583 kcal/mol. The binding affinities of the selected molecules revealed that both could inhibit the binding capacity of the virus during infection. The current results indicate that the selection of candidates and the hypothesis supporting the effectiveness of phytocompounds against rabies might require additional exploration through in vivo research.
abstract_zh: 本研究包括龙葵甲醇提取物的植物化学评价;1.64 % (0.82 g),主要植物化学测试的阳性检出率为 80 %。甲醇和己烷溶剂获得的柱洗脱级分分别以3:7和2:8的比例有效分离化合物。对收集的馏分进行气相色谱质谱研究表明,总共 30 个峰中存在 19 种不同的化合物。鉴定出的主要化合物包括3,3-二甲基哌啶、3-甲基己-2-胺、N-dl-丙氨酰甘氨酸、(S)-(+)-1-环己基乙胺、四三十烷、月桂酰胺、哌嗪、氨基酸及其衍生物。提取物的 2,2-二苯基-2-苦基肼清除生物测定显示出浓度依赖性活性,在 100 μg/mL 时记录的最大值为 68.041 %,抗炎活性为 67.4 %。对目标 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白的 3D 结构研究表明,G 链包含 65.4 Å3 的空腔体积,没有任何隧道,这意味着转运功能较低。发现链 A 具有相对较高的口袋体积(565.1 Å3)以及一个或多个隧道,这表明存在重要的配体结合位点。与 G 链的对接显示,N-dl-丙氨酰甘氨酸具有最高的结合亲和力,对接分数为 -4.86 kcal/mol。另一方面,与A链的对接表明月桂酰胺是两者中最有效的化合物,对接分数为-5.583 kcal/mol。所选分子的结合亲和力表明,两者都可以抑制感染期间病毒的结合能力。目前的结果表明,候选药物的选择和支持植物化合物对抗 狂犬病 有效性的假设可能需要通过体内研究进行额外的探索。

title: Fatal Fulminant Pasteurella multocida Sepsis in a Woman Without Known Comorbidities After Cat Bite: A Case Report and Literature Review
abstract: Pasteurella multocida is a common feline oral commensal that typically causes mild local infections after cat bites, but severe invasive disease is rare and predominantly reported in immunocompromised hosts. We report a fatal case of fulminant P. multocida sepsis in a 51-year-old woman without known comorbidities following cat bites. She presented with progressive bilateral upper limb swelling, and then received rabies and tetanus immunoprophylaxis at a local clinic, but rapidly developed septic shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), and multiple organ dysfunction syndrome (MODS). Conventional cultures were negative, while metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) of wound fluid identified P. multocida on hospital day 3. Despite broad-spectrum antibiotics, mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, and continuous renal replacement therapy, she died on hospital day 4. This case demonstrates that P. multocida can cause fulminant, fatal sepsis in immunocompetent individuals. It underscores the need for strict adherence to current prophylactic antibiotic guidelines for high-risk cat bites and earlier integration of molecular diagnostics in culture-negative, life-threatening infections. Clinicians should start empirical treatment early and monitor closely when the therapeutic window is short.
